story.title: Our Story
story.content: Kayvi Solar was established by solar engineering specialists with a clear purpose: delivering premium, reliable, and cost-effective solar power systems with transparent pricing and complete PM Surya Ghar subsidy assistance. We specialize in precision rooftop engineering, Tier-1 equipment selection, and dedicated local customer care for residential, commercial, and industrial clients across Surat and Gujarat.
